# Psalm 147 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 147:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** The-healer of-the-broken-of heart, and-binder of-their-wounds.
- **LOGOS:** He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
- **PNEUMA:** He heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Counter of-number to-the-stars; to-all-of-them names he-calls.
- **LOGOS:** He determines the number of the stars; he gives to all of them their names.
- **PNEUMA:** He counts the stars and calls each one by name.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** The LORD lifts up the humble; he casts the wicked to the ground.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD lifts up the humble and throws the wicked to the ground.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 147:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Not in-strength-of the-horse he-delights, not in-legs-of the-man he-takes-pleasure.
- **LOGOS:** His delight is not in the strength of the horse, nor his pleasure in the legs of a man,
- **PNEUMA:** He doesn't get excited about the strength of a horse or impressed by human muscle.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 147:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Takes-pleasure YHWH in-those-fearing-him, in-those-hoping in-his-steadfast-love.
- **LOGOS:** but the LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his steadfast love.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD's delight is in those who honor him — those who put their hope in his faithful love.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 147:13 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For he-has-strengthened the-bars-of your-gates; he-has-blessed your-children within-you.
- **LOGOS:** For he strengthens the bars of your gates; he blesses your children within you.
- **PNEUMA:** He has reinforced the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within your walls.
